用电场打开一条路: Open a path with an electric field
拆开封装，找到硅片。: Open the package. Find the die.
先看花纹，再剥开。: See the pattern. Then peel it.
这是一台自制示意手机。处理器藏在电路板上。: An original schematic phone. Its processor sits on the circuit board.
焊球连到电路板，封装保护里面的裸片。: Solder balls connect to the board. The package protects the die.
点一个功能区。位置和面积为示意，不对应真实型号。: Select a region. Positions and areas are schematic.
换到 Tiny Tapeout 02 真实开放电路，平面来自 GDS。: Switch to a real Tiny Tapeout 02 layout, drawn from GDS.
粉色栅跨过绿色有源区，交叉处形成晶体管。: Pink gates cross green active areas to form transistors.
栅极用电场改变沟道；源漏之间的电压推动电流。: The gate field controls the channel. Drain bias drives current.
硅是金刚石型晶格，每个内部原子连着四个邻居。: Silicon has a diamond lattice. Each interior atom has four neighbours.
自制封装 · 结构与尺寸示意: Original package · schematic structure and dimensions
自制功能区 · 不表示面积比例: Original floorplan · areas are not measured proportions
TT02 ALU · 150 × 170 μm · 真实平面，Z 轴夸张: TT02 ALU · 150 × 170 μm · real XY, exaggerated Z

三种结构为独立示意，不是同一芯片的放大照片: Three separate schematics, not magnifications of one chip
球与棒表示位置和近邻关系，不是原子外观: Balls and sticks mark positions and neighbours
CPU 按指令处理通用任务。: A CPU follows instructions for general-purpose tasks.
GPU 把许多相似运算同时展开。: A GPU runs many similar operations in parallel.
缓存把常用数据留在处理器附近。: Cache keeps frequently used data close to the processor.
NPU 为神经网络中的重复计算安排专用通路。: An NPU uses dedicated paths for repeated neural-network operations.
从手里，到封装: From your hand to the package
沿着尺度梯子放大，先找到手机里的芯片。手机、封装与功能区都是自制示意。: Follow the scale ladder into the phone. The phone, package and floorplan are original schematics.
换到一块开放电路，剥开四层金属与局部互连，再进入真实单元。: Switch to an open layout, peel four metal layers and local interconnect, then enter a real cell.
提高栅源电压，比较平面、鳍式与环栅怎样控制沟道。: Raise gate voltage and compare channel control in planar, fin and GAA devices.
从反相器、与非门走到四位加法器，输入两个数，跟着进位走。: Move from inverters and NAND gates to a four-bit adder. Enter two numbers and follow the carry.
可旋转和连续缩放的芯片旅程: Rotate and continuously zoom through a chip
真实单元 sky130_fd_sc_hd__inv_2；有 NMOS 与 PMO: Real sky130_fd_sc_hd__inv_2 cell, with NMOS and PMOS.
实际四层铝金属，下面还有局部互连。: Four actual aluminium layers, with local interconnect below.
露出有源区与栅，继续放大看交叉处。: Active areas and gates are exposed. Zoom into their crossings.
栅只从上方控制平面的沟道。: The gate controls a flat channel from above.
把沟道竖成鳍，栅从三面包住它，更容易关住电流。: A vertical fin lets the gate wrap three sides, improving control when switching off.
把沟道做成悬空薄片，栅从四周环绕，进一步加强控制。: Suspended sheets let the gate wrap all four sides for stronger control.
公开示例：鳍宽 8 nm、鳍高 42 nm；结构示意: Published example: 8 nm fin width, 42 nm height; schematic
栅压形成沟道，漏源电压推动电流。: Gate voltage forms a channel; drain bias drives current.
沟道已形成；漏源电压为零，没有持续净电流。: A channel exists, but zero drain bias means no sustained net current.
提高栅压，观察栅下的沟道。: Raise gate voltage and watch the channel form.
屏幕像书页一样翻开，下面是电池、电路板和处理器。点亮框里的处理器，继续向里。: The display folds open like a page, revealing the battery, board and processor. Select the outlined processor to go deeper.
封装把微小的裸片接到更大的电路板上。抬起上盖，看见里面的硅。: The package connects a tiny die to a larger board. Lift the lid to reveal silicon.
晶体管由大量原子构成。硅晶格的重复边长约 0.543 nm；图中只显示一小块晶格: A transistor contains many atoms. Silicon's lattice repeats every 0.543 nm; this is a small sample.
换到真实开放电路: Switch to the real open layout
下一站换样本：不是这款示意 SoC，而是 SKY130 的 TT02 ALU 宏: Next we change samples: from this schematic SoC to a SKY130 TT02 ALU macro.
头发，和一排开关: A hair and a row of switches
取约 100 μm 宽的头发作比较，约能跨过 1,400 个晶体管栅极节距。: A roughly 100 μm-wide hair spans about 1,400 transistor gate pitches.
70 nm 是公开的 Intel 14 nm 工艺栅极节距，含相邻栅的间隔；不是: 70 nm is Intel's published 14 nm gate pitch, including spacing. It is not a whole transistor width or this SKY130 layout's pitch.
手机、封装、功能区是自制示意，不对应某款产品。进入开放电路时切换到 Ryan C: The phone, package and floorplan are original schematics. The open circuit switches to Ryan Cornateanu's Tiny Tapeout 02 ALU.
GDS 保留实际平面图形。只显示 M1–M4、局部互连、接触孔与器件掩膜。颜色、: GDS preserves the actual plan. Only M1–M4, local interconnect, contacts and device masks are shown. Colors and Z dimensions aid inspection; dielectrics are omitted.
三种晶体管独立建模，结构不按比例。共用的 0.65 V 阈值和电流模型只用于因果: The three transistor schematics are not to scale. Their shared 0.65 V threshold and current model teach causality, not process performance.
加法器是独立的 36 个与非门教学网表，不是 ALU 宏的真实仿真。原子位置取金: The adder is a separate 36-NAND teaching netlist, not a simulation of the ALU macro. Atom positions follow the diamond lattice; radii and bonds are illustrative.
门级教学模型 · 非真实 ALU 网表: Gate-level teaching model · separate from the ALU netlist
一个输入翻过来：0 变 1，1 变 0。: Invert one input: 0 becomes 1, and 1 becomes 0.
只有两个输入都为 1，与非门才输出 0。: A NAND gate outputs 0 only when both inputs are 1.
两个数位加一个进位，得到一个和、一个新进位。: Add two bits and a carry to produce a sum and a new carry.
从最低位开始，进位依次传给下一位。: Start at the lowest bit. Each carry feeds the next bit.
CMOS 反相器由一个 PMOS 和一个 NMOS 配合开关。: A CMOS inverter combines one PMOS and one NMOS switch.
CMOS 与非门的上拉并联，下拉串联，共四个晶体管。: A CMOS NAND has parallel pull-ups and series pull-downs: four transistors.
每一位用 9 个与非门；两组四门网络完成异或，最后一门产生进位。: Each bit uses nine NANDs: two four-gate XOR networks and a carry gate.
先经过反相器理解“非”，再把与非门组成异或与进位。这里的 36 门模型只用与非门: An inverter introduces NOT. NAND networks then build XOR and carry. This 36-gate model uses NAND alone for four-bit addition.
信号按逻辑依赖逐拍展开；这是教学顺序，不是芯片的真实传播时间。: Signals unfold by logical dependency. The ticks are a teaching sequence, not real chip timing.
